entry.title: Wembley Stadium
entry.note: Pitch goal axis is east-west, so native+X follows it and native-Z is the north Olympic Way entrance and arch. Footprint and aperture are independently mapped. Arch map itself records artistic plan interpolation, therefore only its approximately315m feet and north-side position are used; the22degree geometry comes from the designer. Ground contactY0 preserves feet and playing field, with north stair/entrance grade reconstructed from published views. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
